title: Closeout summary: Replace dataRequirements with typed payload interfaces
body:
## Agent Finish Summary

Replaced registry-owned dataRequirements with typed directive payload contracts. Added packages/core/src/agent-directive-payloads.ts with one payload interface and field contract per directive registry id, removed the registry requirement() helper and dataRequirements arrays, and switched compiler, health, CLI registry show, docs, and tests to consume agentDirectivePayloadFields. Also reused atomic storage writes for file lock owner heartbeat files so the full suite remains stable.

Close reason: Typed payload contract migration complete and verified.
